description: Synthetic, deterministic. The run used a test that expected the h1 to read 'My Profile' (the app shows 'Profile'), so it failed as a test-code defect. After the run, the spec was edited to expect 'Profile' and was not re-run: the current source's line 6 differs from the error snippet, its modification time is later than the run, and the as-run source still appears in error-context.md and the trace. The historical failure is a test-code defect; whether the current source passes is unknown until it is re-run.

reviewableAlternatives.note: Declining to diagnose because the source no longer matches the artifacts is defensible; a person must judge it

requires.description: Grounds it in the source/artifact mismatch

rootCause.summary: The run failed on toHaveText('My Profile') (the heading is 'Profile'); the source was changed after the run, so it no longer matches the artifacts and a re-run is needed to know the current state.

criteria.description: Says the source changed after the run / does not match the artifacts
Names what the run actually asserted ('My Profile')
Says a re-run is needed to confirm the current state

forbiddenClaims.description: Assumes the failure still exists in the current source
Treats the corrected current source as proof that the earlier failure never happened
Reasons from the current source alone that the test is correct

requiredEvidence.why: Failure data must come from the MCP tools
The current source must be compared with the error snippet and its modification time with the run start

acceptable.description: Re-run the test to confirm the edited source
